messages.body: Intermediate asks for depth. Take one subject at a time and let it settle.
Connect today's topic to one you already know. Understanding grows that way.
Many chapters, one steady routine. You can manage it.
Intermediate is won on practice. Attempt the questions before reading the answers.
Plan the group, divide the chapters, and protect your study hours.
Revise the heavy subjects twice. Once is rarely enough at this level.
Reaching Intermediate was an achievement. Keep adding to it today.
Every subject you finish lightens the work ahead of you.
You are building real professional knowledge. Notice how far it has come.
